incidents.summary: Applied Nutrition pleaded guilty to health and safety failings after a worker lost three fingers and part of his palm while cleaning machinery, and was fined £70,000 plus costs.

sources.title: Worker's fingers severed while working at sports nutrition supplier Applied Nutrition | Lancs Live
sources.quote: This resulted in three of the man's fingers and part of the palm being severed on his right hand.

sources.title: Worker's fingers severed while working at sports nutrition supplier Applied Nutrition | Lancs Live
sources.quote: An investigation by the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) found that the company had no risk assessments or safe systems of work in place.

sources.title: Applied Nutrition Ltd fined after worker’s hand severed
sources.quote: Applied Nutrition Ltd of 2 Acornfield Road, Knowsley Industrial Park, Liverpool, pleaded guilty to breaching Section 2 (1) of the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974. The company was fined £70,000 and ordered to pay costs of £4,551.10.

positives: Applied Nutrition's ten new Premium Whey Protein Powder flavors were reported as Halal certified.
